entry.title: Roseburg Council Approves Expanded Stewart Park Master Plan Update
entry.summary: Roseburg councilors approved a $289,020 update to the Stewart Park Master Plan, expanding it to include Gaddis Park and the Umpqua Greenway. A $125,000 Ford Family Foundation grant will help fund the yearlong planning process.

entry.title: Roseburg Council Ends Review of Downtown Campground Sites, Calls for Work Study
entry.summary: Roseburg councilors voted 6-2 to stop evaluating two downtown lots for an urban campground. They unanimously called for a work study of city-managed, operator-managed, and unmanaged camp options.

entry.title: Oregon Sets 2027 Rent Increase Limit at 10%
entry.summary: Oregon’s rent increase limit will rise to 10% in 2027 for most covered rentals, including those in Douglas County. A separate 6% limit applies to spaces in larger manufactured home parks and marinas. Here’s what renters should know.

entry.title: Hogan Road Fire Near Oakland Burns 7 Acres; DFPA Reminds Public That Fire Restrictions Remain in Effect

entry.title: Historic Rail Car Reunited With Dillard Depot After 16-Year Restoration
